To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(a) interdependence information can improve cooperation, and (b) this improvement is mediated by an increase in reciprocating cooperation.

(i) interdependence information increases both individual cooperation and mutual (i.e., reciprocal) cooperation; (ii) interdependence information also increases joint performance and satisfaction; (iii) these effects are mediated by the increased use of reciprocity as a strategy; and (iv) the effects of information on reciprocity are stronger for individuals who score higher on the Big Five personality trait of Agreeableness.
(1) awareness of interdependence increases cooperation in social interactions and (2) this effect is driven by an increase in reciprocating cooperation, in response to a counterpart's cooperation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of awareness of interdependence and its effect on cooperation.
the role of awareness of interdependence in social interactions.
the effects of information about interdependence on cooperation in social interactions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper has demonstrated the importance of information in social interactions and the impact of information on cooperation.
the results of this experiment indicate that when participants are given information about interdependence, cooperation is increased.
the more information people had about interdependence, the more likely they would cooperate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the information about interdependence has a positive effect on cooperation, and the information about interdependency is a key factor in the decision to cooperate.
the more information people have, the more likely it is that people are going to cooperate.
the more you know about your interdependence, the more likely you will cooperate and the more likely you and your counterpart will cooperate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
awareness of interdependence encourages cooperation in social interactions.
awareness of interdependence can increase cooperative behavior.
people are more likely to behave cooperatively when they are made aware of their interdependence.
